text: Should the first Map Maker slice include all four symmetry tools from the references: left/right, top/bottom, 180-degree duplication, and four-way? The draft recommends all four, with atomic preview/undo and separate explicit spawn/objective tools. Alternatives are 180-degree duplication only, or leaving symmetry outside the first slice. This is a scope decision because the original BRL-0037 specification did not include symmetry.
Include all four symmetry tools in the first Map Maker slice: Left/Right, Top/Bottom, Rotate 180°, and Four-way, with the atomic preview/undo and explicit spawn/objective boundaries specified.
